summary: Phase 3 Features Testing Complete - All 4 major features (Voice Assistant, Teleconsultation, Insurance Integration, Health Packages) tested and working. Backend APIs (23/23 tests passed) and Frontend UI components verified.

voice_assistant.details: Multi-language support (English, Hindi, Marathi), mic button, quick commands, language selector, AI-powered responses with intent extraction

teleconsultation.details: Three consultation types (Video ₹500, Voice ₹300, Chat ₹200), doctor list with availability, booking dialog with date/time/reason fields

insurance_integration.details: My Policy and Claims tabs, Add Insurance Policy dialog with provider selector and policy number input, Verify & Add Policy button

health_packages.details: 5 packages displayed (Basic ₹1,499, Diabetes ₹2,499, Women's ₹3,499, Senior ₹4,999, Maternity ₹24,999), discount badges, test lists, booking dialog with date picker and instructions

/api/features/packages.sample_response: Returns 5 health packages with pricing, discounts, and included tests

/api/features/packages/book.sample_response: Returns booking_id (PKG prefix), instructions for fasting and arrival

/api/features/voice/process-command.sample_response: Returns intent, extracted_data (doctor, date, time), response_text in selected language

/api/features/teleconsult/request.sample_response: Returns consultation_id, status (pending), estimated_fee based on type

/api/features/teleconsult/upcoming.sample_response: Returns list of upcoming consultations with doctor info and status

/api/features/insurance/verify.sample_response: Returns verified status, coverage details for consultation/pharmacy/lab_test/hospitalization

/api/features/insurance/claims.sample_response: Returns list of submitted claims with status and amounts

test_credentials.otp: Dynamic - displayed on screen as 'Test OTP: XXXXXX'

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 features fully tested. All 4 features working: Voice Assistant (multi-language with GPT-4o), Teleconsultation (video/audio/chat booking), Insurance Integration (policy verification + claims), Health Packages (5 packages with booking). APIs use EMERGENT_LLM_KEY for AI features. Patient login via OTP at /api/patients/portal/send-otp and /api/patients/portal/verify-otp.

mocked_apis_list: /api/features/insurance/verify - Returns MOCK coverage for star_health, hdfc_ergo, icici_lombard providers
/api/features/packages - Returns predefined health packages (not from database)
/api/features/voice/transcribe - May fail without actual audio file, but process-command works with text input
mocked_api.note: Insurance verification returns mock data for demo providers. Voice command processing uses GPT-4o via Emergent LLM Key and returns ai_powered: true.
